title: Sign in to the Workspace
body: Use your ThaiJO or ORCID account. The system pulls in your context, such as your field, past publications and the journals you are affiliated with.

title: Ask, or choose a tool
body: Type a question in Thai or English, or choose a specialized tool such as Reference Extraction & Validation.

title: The agent plans and calls tools
body: The AI Agent Orchestrator splits the question into subtasks for subagents, which call Skills and MCP servers through the TCI MCP Gateway. It re-plans when data falls short and shows every step.

title: Get a cited answer
body: Every statement links back to its source article in ThaiJO or an international database. Export it as a report, BibTeX or RIS, or save it in the Workspace.
